### SUMMARY
Mapped the complete options-data surface in D:\antigravity_sandbox\Nifty. `options_flow.py` (765 lines, 9 functions) is a pure analytics/display layer: only `compute_short_term_directional_vector` reaches app.py's main tab, and every v5.1 strike-level function (`heatmap`, `gex_chart`, `range_forecast`, `pcr_and_max_pain`) is compute-and-display-only in tab_oi — none feed signal/ticket/decision logic. `options_engine.py`'s chain-analysis functions are similarly display/dead: `compute_full_chain_gex_profile` has zero call sites; the live decision GEX gate (`decision_engine.py:111-113`) is fed by a hardcoded-approximation `compute_dealer_gex` (src/indicators.py:635), not by any chain-based GEX. Missing entirely: PCR z-score vs history, ITM/OTM OI shift, max-pain drift, expected-vs-actual move, OI concentration ratios.

### EVIDENCE
**options_flow.py inventory** (all return `Dict[str,Any]`):
- `compute_atm_straddle_metrics(spot, option_chain_df=None, live_iv, t_days=4.0, r)` :25 — cols `strikePrice/strike`, `CE_ltp/PE_ltp`, `CE_volume/PE_volume`; BSM fallback. Returns atm_strike, call/put_premium, straddle_premium, upper/lower_breakeven, range_width_pts, expected_move_pct, straddle_vwap, vol_state, spot_range_pct (:87-99). Call: options_flow.py:318; imported app.py:52 (no direct app call).
- `compute_cumulative_oi_delta_and_traps(option_chain_df, spot=24800, prev_chain_df)` :102 — cols `CE_oi/PE_oi`, `CE_changeinOpenInterest/PE_changeinOpenInterest`. Returns net_oi_delta, net_oi_pulse_score, call_wall, put_wall, active_quadrant, trap_flag, trap_warning, total_ce/pe_oi_change, strike_diagnostics (:213-224). Call: :327; imported app.py:53.
- `compute_pcr_momentum_derivative(current_pcr, prev_pcr, delta_t_mins=15)` :227 — returns dpcr_dt_per_min, pcr_momentum_score, status. Call: :335.
- `compute_vanna_charm_drift_vector(spot, strike, iv, d_iv_dt, t_days, r)` :256 — returns vanna, charm_daily, drift_score, regime. Call: :339.
- `compute_short_term_directional_vector(spot, df, option_chain_df, prev_chain_df, live_iv, prev_pcr, hfi_score)` :304 — needs price df `close` col; returns directional_vector, conviction_pct, bias, suggested_action, target/stop_price, straddle/oi/pcr/vanna_charm_metrics, component_scores (:390-410). Call: app.py:397 (display-only: :535-546, :773-774, :1510-1543).
- `_extract_normalized_chain` :417 — private normalizer → strike, ce_oi, pe_oi, ce_change_oi, pe_change_oi, ce_volume, pe_volume, ce_ltp, pe_ltp; synthetic fallback if None.
- `compute_oi_based_range_forecast(option_chain_df, spot, max_pain=None)` :486 — returns put_wall, call_wall, max_pain, spot_position_pct, location_bias, expected_corridor, bias_description (:545-557). Calls: :664, app.py:1601.
- `compute_oi_change_heatmap(option_chain_df, spot, range_pts=500, highlight_threshold_mult=2.0)` :560 — returns heatmap_rows (strike, ce/pe_oi, ce/pe_change_oi, ce/pe_volume, net_strike_oi_delta, is_hot_ce/pe, color_intensity, ce/pe_regime), hot_ce/pe_strikes, total_ce/pe_writing, writing_bias, support, resistance, range_forecast (:666-676). Call: app.py:1599.
- `compute_strike_level_gex_chart_data(option_chain_df, spot, iv, t_days=4.0)` :679 — per-strike GEX via BSM gamma × OI × LOT_SIZE; returns strikes, net/call/put_gex_per_strike, call_wall_strike, put_wall_strike, zero_gex_strike, net_dealer_regime, total_*_gex_cr (:752-764). Call: app.py:1600.

**options_engine.py**:
- `calculate_pcr_and_max_pain(option_chain_df)` :916 — normalized cols strike/ce_oi/pe_oi/ce_change_oi/pe_change_oi/ce_volume/pe_volume; returns max_pain_strike, pcr_oi, pcr_sentiment, pcr_change_oi, pcr_volume, total_*_, min_payout_loss, pain_distribution(df), strikes_analyzed (:1021-1036). Calls: app.py:1586, options_flow.py:523.
- `compute_full_chain_gex_profile(option_chain_df, spot, iv, t_days=3.5)` :1039 — returns call_wall, put_wall, zero_gex_strike, total_net_gex_cr, is_positive_gamma, gamma_regime, gex_df (:1106-1114). **No call sites** (app.py:43 import only).
- `select_institutional_strike(spot, is_call, t_days, iv, is_0dte_afternoon)` :1167 — spot+delta only, no chain; returns strike, option_type, symbol, regime_mode + greeks (:1203-1209). Call: :1332 (inside `generate_option_trade_ticket` → consumed by trade logic).
- `compute_0dte_gamma_scalp_parameters(spot, strike, dte_days, iv, is_call, current_time_str, mode, atr, r, q)` :238 — returns regime, greeks, gamma_explosion_multiplier, charm_hourly_drift, tightened_sl, gamma_surge_targets, strike_playbook, execution_mandates (:308-359). Call: :1416 (inside ticket generator).
- IV-surface: `compute_volatility_surface` :30, `compute_svi_volatility_skew` :53, `generate_svi_smile_curve` :83 (display at app.py:1560).

**Q3 compute-and-display-only**: pcr_analytics app.py:1586, oi_hm_res :1599, gex_chart_res :1600, range_fc_res :1601 → only st.metric/plotly/HTML (:1590-1593, :1607-1671); never reach `signal`/`ticket`/decision_engine. `dir_flow_res` :397 likewise display-only. `compute_full_chain_gex_profile` dead code.

**Q4 expected columns** (confirmed by tests): raw NSE form `strikePrice/CE_oi/PE_oi/CE_changeinOpenInterest/PE_changeinOpenInterest/CE_ltp/PE_ltp/CE_volume/PE_volume` (tests/test_options_flow.py:37-46); normalized `strike/ce_oi/pe_oi/ce_change_oi/pe_change_oi/ce_volume/pe_volume` (test_v51_oi_heatmap.py:31, test_options_flow.py:184-191). `expiry` needed only for app.py expiry filter (:1578-1580). **No per-strike IV column is ever read** — IV is always a scalar param (`live_iv`/`iv_input`).

**Q5 gaps** (keyword greps across src/): PCR z-score vs history — absent (z-score hits only `OFI_ZSCORE`/`SKEW_ZSCORE` in config.py:39,100). ITM/OTM OI shift — absent. Max-pain drift — absent (single snapshot). Expected-vs-actual move — `expected_move_pct` computed (:78) but never compared to realized range. OI concentration/activity ratio — absent (heatmap has raw volume per strike only). Call/put writing flow — present (heatmap writing_bias + traps). Gamma regime — chain-based versions exist (`net_dealer_regime` :750, `gamma_regime` :1112) but decision gate consumes `compute_dealer_gex` (indicators.py:635-647) which returns `net_gex_crores/is_positive_gamma/gamma_flip_strike` — **no `call_wall_strike`/`put_wall_strike` keys**, so decision_engine.py:112-113 falls back to defaults 999999/0 (GEX wall pinning gate inert).

### GAPS
Above, plus: no historical/state persistence anywhere for PCR/max-pain/GEX (all snapshot functions); `compute_dealer_gex` uses hardcoded OI defaults (14.5M/12.8M) despite live chain availability.

### NEXT
A "trend & range engine" can reuse: straddle corridor, COID/trap detection, OI walls+range forecast, writing-bias, strike GEX chart data, PCR (level+momentum), max-pain. Must build: historical PCR z-score, ITM/OTM OI shift, max-pain/GEX time-series drift, expected-vs-actual move tracking, OI concentration ratios, and wiring chain-based GEX walls (`compute_strike_level_gex_chart_data` keys) into decision_engine's `gex_walls` (fixing the key mismatch).

### CHANGES
None.

### BLOCKERS
None.

### SUMMARY
Audited the signal pipeline in `D:\antigravity_sandbox\Nifty`. `evaluate_bar` runs once per Streamlit auto-refresh (5–60 s) on the last bar only; `log_signal` persists every evaluation (WAITs included, collapsed per bar/direction). The confluence score is computed only post-hoc in the journal for display — no score gate exists in the strategy ladder, so every trade-emitting branch can execute with a sub-70 score. Several order-flow/sweep/absorption branches bypass HTF alignment and force `htf_aligned=True`; VPIN and VCR are computed but never gated; `MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY=3` and consecutive-loss locks exist only in the backtester, not live. On restart, `seed_from_intraday_history` replays the day's bars and re-logs every historical signal into the live journal.

### EVIDENCE
- Cadence: `app.py:276-294` — `st_autorefresh` every 5–60 s; `app.py:348` `evaluate_bar(df, live_iv, hfi_score)` once per run, `current_idx=-1` → last bar only.
- Journaling: `app.py:396-411` `log_signal(...)` every refresh; `signal_journal.py:300-310` — WAITs logged unless last entry is also WAIT (`:304`), dedup on `bar_timestamp+direction` (`:308-310`). `app.py:402` passes hardcoded `confluence_score=1.0` (overridden by recompute at `signal_journal.py:317-320`).
- Confluence formula: `signal_journal.py:138-245` — HTF ±25 (`:166-176`), EMA200/55 ±15 (`:179-184`), AVWAP/ValueArea ±15 (`:187-198`), Kalman ±15 (`:201-206`), OFI ±15 (`:209-217`), Fib pocket ±10 (`:220-226`), GEX/Markov +5 (`:229-232`). Grades: ≥85 A+ / ≥70 A / ≥55 B / else C (`:236-243`). No grade gate anywhere; score never computed inside `strategy_rules.py` (grep: zero hits).
- Trade branches (all fire without any confluence/score check): 3PM `:202-228`; absorption-trap `:320-346`; liquidity-sweep `:352-378`; mean-reversion (regime-gated only) `:385-406`; IB breakout (regime+HTF+volume gated) `:416-441`; AMT value-area `:447-473`; V-reversal `:482-514`; order-flow absorption `:520-546`; stacked delta `:550-576`; golden-pocket LONG/SHORT `:677-694`, `:734-751`.
- Gates present: freak-candle WAIT `:178-191`; 3PM `:193-228` (no vetoes); lunch-lull note only `:136-137`, `:233-238` (advisory, no halving applied); skew crash gate (LONG only) `:617-627`; HFI veto LONG/SHORT `:630-640`, `:700-710`; GEX call-wall pin `:643-653`; HTF veto `:655-665`, `:712-722`; MA-stretch WAIT `:581-594`. VPIN computed `:258` but never used; VCR `:273` only in details dicts `:331,345,692,749`; `session_losses` init `:102` never read (dead).

None.

### RISKS
- Retail-trap leakage: order-flow/sweep/absorption/mean-reversion branches (lines 320-576) execute with no HTF alignment check, no score gate, and force `htf_aligned=True`; mitigation: require `htf_aligned_long/short` and score ≥70 before emitting a trade.
